package handler

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"GENRE_MODULE/game/scenarionet"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

func TestScenarioRobotTCPRetryAndReconnect(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	auth := gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, token string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		id := int64(0)
		switch token {
		case "fixture-owner":
			id = f.players[0].ID()
		case "fixture-peer":
			id = f.players[1].ID()
		case "fixture-outsider":
			id = f.outsider.ID()
		default:
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: id, SessionID: token, ServerID: 1}, nil
	})
	cfg := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	cfg.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(cfg, scenarionet.Dispatch(f.engine), auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	run := bots.Smoke(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}}, f.room.ID(), func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket("fixture-owner"), nil })
	if err := run.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if stats := run.Stats(); stats.Success != 1 || stats.Failure != 0 || stats.Canceled != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("robot failed: %+v", stats)
	}
	if state := f.state(t); state.Revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("retry committed twice: %+v", state)
	}
}
